article.title: -(으)ㄹ 것 같다
article.part: Discurso referido y evidencialidad — 간접화법과 증거성

claims.summary: The construction -(으)ㄹ 것 같다 expresses a prediction, possibility, or conjecture about something that has not yet been realized or confirmed. It conveys a lower degree of certainty compared to other statements and does not refer to the speech itself but presents the speaker's own assessment.

The structure of -(으)ㄹ 것 같다 is explained, including the combination of the modifier -(으)ㄹ with 것 같다, the placement of the modifier depending on the root's ending, and examples of its usage with different verbs.
Several examples are provided to illustrate how -(으)ㄹ 것 같다 is used in different contexts, such as predicting future events, expressing expectations, and making evaluations about situations.
